outcome: time to achieve full enteral feeds
delayed full enteral feeds (after 28 days of life)
prolonged length of hospital stay (discharge after 30 days of life)
cohort: The study participants were 60 mothers and their infants born with gastroschisis at a Level IV NICU.
finding: The presence of histologic chorioamnionitis was not associated with delayed full enteral feeds or prolonged length of hospital stay in infants with gastroschisis.
